nodes.label: CLAUDE.md — project context for Claude Code
IRON RULES (Rules 1–8)
nodes.rationale: No fake data, no hardcoded values, business logic in services only, i18n everywhere; violations prohibited

nodes.label: PRODUCT RULES (benchmark-first, DoD = eyes-on scenario)
nodes.rationale: Owner 2026-07-21: piecemeal fixes produced visual garbage and dead-ends; benchmark before code, no new gates, observations are symptoms not backlog, DoD = scenario passed by eyes

nodes.label: Local make gates mirror CI (fixed 2026-08-13)
nodes.rationale: Before 08-13 none of make lint/security/i18n-check/typecheck actually checked anything; lesson: a gate must be validated with a deliberately broken input

nodes.label: Rule: a gate is proven only by a broken input
nodes.rationale: tsc --noEmit with solution-style tsconfig checked ZERO files in CI too; 'target ran' != 'target checked'

nodes.label: Business date = timezone.localdate()
nodes.rationale: USE_TZ=True; now().date() lags a day 00:00–05:00 Tashkent; invoices printed yesterday's date; guarded by core/tests/test_business_date_timezone.py

nodes.label: AI layer ARCH-01: no LLM in request path
nodes.rationale: 8 interactive AI endpoints enqueue sourcing.run_ai_job on Celery queue ai, answer 202 task_id; single-attempt because handlers are paid per call

nodes.label: Post-contract path (deal card as hub, server-computed sides, bilateral act)
nodes.rationale: Act trigger is delivery, not payment (Odoo/SAP/IFRS 15); OVERDUE not stored — computed from due_date

nodes.label: Caddy config as managed repo fragment (apply-caddy.yml)
nodes.rationale: Reload restarts an edge shared with a neighbour site — applied only manually with APPLY confirmation; deploy only checks drift
